<!--
  Copy this template next to your manuscript:
    file.copy(system.file("templates", "sr-report.qmd", package = "recueil"), ".")
  then render it with the review id:
    quarto render sr-report.qmd -P review:<id>
  It needs RECUEIL_URL and RECUEIL_TOKEN (a token with sr:read) in the environment.
  Everything below is a skeleton: the numbers come from the library, the prose is yours.
-->

```{r setup}
library(recueil)
con <- rc_connect()
review <- params$review
stopifnot(nzchar(review))
snapshot <- if (nzchar(params$snapshot)) params$snapshot else NULL
meta <- rc_sr_reviews(con)
meta <- meta[meta$id == review, ]
counts <- rc_sr_prisma(con, review, snapshot = snapshot, template = FALSE)
n <- function(key) counts$n[counts$data == key]
```

# `r meta$title`

**Question.** `r meta$question`

## Methods

### Information sources and search

```{r searches}
runs <- recueil:::rc_json(con, paste0("/reviews/", review, "/searches"))$data
knitr::kable(runs[, c("sourceDatabase", "interface", "executedAt", "recordsReturned", "recordsImported", "duplicatesRemoved")],
             col.names = c("Database", "Interface", "Date", "Returned", "Imported", "Duplicates"))
```

The full search strategies, verbatim, are in the supplement (PRISMA-S item 8):

```{r strategies, results = "asis"}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(runs))) cat(sprintf("**%s** (%s)\n\n```\n%s\n```\n\n", runs$sourceDatabase[i], substr(runs$executedAt[i], 1, 10), runs$queryString[i]))
```

### Selection process

Records were deduplicated (`r n("duplicates")` duplicates removed), then screened on title and
abstract and, where they passed, on full text, with reasons recorded for every full-text exclusion.
`r if (isTRUE(meta$automationDisclosure)) "Decisions assisted by software are flagged in the audit trail (supplement)." else ""`

## Results

### Study selection

```{r prisma, fig.cap = "PRISMA 2020 flow diagram."}
if (requireNamespace("PRISMA2020", quietly = TRUE)) {
  PRISMA2020::PRISMA_flowdiagram(PRISMA2020::PRISMA_data(rc_sr_prisma(con, review, snapshot = snapshot)), interactive = FALSE, previous = FALSE, other = TRUE)
} else {
  knitr::kable(counts)
}
```

The searches identified `r n("database_results")` records from databases and
`r n("register_results")` from registers. After removing `r n("duplicates")` duplicates,
`r n("records_screened")` records were screened, `r n("records_excluded")` excluded on title and
abstract, `r n("dbr_assessed")` reports assessed in full, and `r n("new_studies")` studies
(`r n("new_reports")` reports) included.

### Study characteristics

```{r included}
knitr::kable(rc_sr_included(con, review)[, c("study", "title", "year", "venue", "doi")])
```

### Risk of bias

```{r rob, fig.cap = "Risk of bias."}
rob <- tryCatch(rc_sr_rob(con, review, params$rob_tool), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(rob) && nrow(rob) > 0 && requireNamespace("robvis", quietly = TRUE)) {
  robvis::rob_traffic_light(rob, tool = toupper(sub("_", "-", params$rob_tool)))
}
```

### Synthesis

```{r synthesis}
wide <- rc_sr_extraction(con, review, "wide")
cols <- c("sr_events_treatment", "sr_n_treatment", "sr_events_control", "sr_n_control")
if (requireNamespace("metafor", quietly = TRUE) && all(cols %in% names(wide))) {
  outcome <- wide[!is.na(wide$group) & startsWith(wide$group, "outcome:") & stats::complete.cases(wide[, cols]), ]
  if (nrow(outcome) >= 2) {
    es <- metafor::escalc(measure = "RR", ai = sr_events_treatment, n1i = sr_n_treatment, ci = sr_events_control, n2i = sr_n_control, data = outcome, slab = study)
    fit <- metafor::rma(yi, vi, data = es)
    metafor::forest(fit, atransf = exp)
    print(fit)
  }
}
```
